name: Loan and mortgage payments
description: Monthly payment, total paid and total interest for an amortised loan.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/,(?=\d{3})/g,'');const m=t.match(/(?:\$|£|€)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(k|m|thousand|million)?\b|(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(k|thousand|million)?\s*(?:dollar|pound|euro)?s?\s*(?:mortgage|loan)/);const mult=s=>!s?1:/^(k|thousand)$/.test(s)?1e3:1e6;const P=m?(+(m[1]||m[3]))*mult(m[2]||m[4]):null;const rate=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(%|percent)/);const yrs=t.match(/(\d+)\s*(years?|yrs?|-year)/),mos=t.match(/(\d+)\s*months?\b/);if(!P||!rate||!(yrs||mos))return{answer:null,reason:'Need the loan amount, interest rate and term.'};const n=yrs?+yrs[1]*12:+mos[1],r=+rate[1]/100/12;const pay=r===0?P/n:P*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);const f=v=>v.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});return{answer:`${f(pay)} a month (total ${f(pay*n)}, interest ${f(pay*n-P)})`,steps:[`Loan P = ${f(P)}, monthly rate r = ${rate[1]}% ÷ 12 = ${+r.toFixed(6)}, payments n = ${n}`,'Payment = P·r·(1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n − 1)',`Payment = ${f(pay)}`,`Total paid = ${f(pay*n)}; interest = ${f(pay*n-P)}`]}}
